```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)
library(huxtable)

# don't show code unless we explicitly set echo = TRUE
opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.pos = "H")
opts <- options(knitr.kable.NA = "")

## control long outputs by using eg `max.lines = 10`
hook_output_default <- knitr::knit_hooks$get('output')
truncate_to_lines <- function(x, n) {
   if (!is.null(n)) {
      x = unlist(stringr::str_split(x, '\n'))
      if (length(x) > n) {
         # truncate the output
         x = c(head(x, n), '...\n')
      }
      x = paste(x, collapse = '\n') # paste first n lines together
   }
   x
}
knitr::knit_hooks$set(output = function(x, options) {
   max.lines <- options$max.lines
   x <- truncate_to_lines(x, max.lines)
   hook_output_default(x, options)
})
```

```{r jquery-before-keprint, include=FALSE}
# kableExtra's kable_styling() pulls in kePrint.js, which is plain jQuery
# ($(document).ready(...)). rmarkdown emits html_dependencies near the TOP of
# <head> but places `includes: in_header` at the BOTTOM, so the jQuery loaded
# there arrives after kePrint and the page throws
#   ReferenceError: $ is not defined
# Registering a jQuery dependency here -- from _setup.Rmd, which every deck
# sources first -- puts it ahead of kePrint in the emitted <head>.
#
# Borrow rmarkdown's own bundled copy: its source sits in the R library, so it
# cannot collide with this project's lib_dir. (Pointing a dependency at
# libs/jquery-3.6.0 would make rmarkdown copy that folder onto itself and
# empty it.) Guarded, since html_dependency_jquery() is rmarkdown-internal.
local({
  jq <- try(rmarkdown:::html_dependency_jquery(), silent = TRUE)
  if (!inherits(jq, "try-error")) invisible(knitr::knit_meta_add(list(jq)))
})
```
